name: Word Wizard 3D
description:
WORD WIZARD 3D Is a collection of
classic word games. The player is
invited to create, compose and find
words in addictive and absorbing
gameplay. Levels of difficulty naturally
increase as the players advance
through the game making it suitable
for all ages.
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
